mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand and economic expansion, which typically leads to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST rises by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 325.0, it signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 325.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a tightening monetary policy during a strong labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with strong labor market
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an impending slowdown in manufacturing, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of late-cycle expansion periods when INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: Strong job growth (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS rises by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 735,000 million dollars, it signals strong consumer demand that boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 735000.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a broad-based economic expansion, which typically results in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO rise simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.0% leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% during monetary tightening cycles.
